notes: Partition verified: 10 source and 12 target IDs each used once.

τοῖς ἡμετέροις λόγοις is rule 54: the first-person plural possessive adjective names the possessor itself and takes *our*, so the article is unrepresented. This is the ἴδιος contrast rule 54 draws in terms.

The fronted *of whom* keeps its *of* with the relative pronoun; no Greek preposition is expressed for it to answer to, so it is a rule 7 helper on the word it fronts with. Reading *of* as a phrasal particle on φυλάσσου is the competing analysis and is recorded in the unit's note.
καί → *also* is aligned under rule 65's English-side test rather than left unrepresented.
